title: derris marginata
intro: Derris marginata, commonly known as the Derris plant, is a type of legume native to tropical Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing fever, alleviating rheumatism, and treating various types of skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Derris marginata are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe and protect the body from damage. The bioactive constituents of Derris marginata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
